data.title: Measure with Little Feet!
data.description: Learn how to measure fun everyday objects by guessing how many little feet will fit and then finding out!

challenges.instruction: Look at the crayon. Can you guess how many little feet long it is? Make your guess, then place the feet to measure!
challenges.hint: Try counting the spaces carefully from one end of the crayon to the other.
challenges.narration: Let us measure this crayon together! First, take a guess at how many feet long it is.

challenges.instruction: Now look at the straw. How many little feet do you think will fit along the straw? Guess first, then tile to check!
challenges.hint: Remember to place the feet right next to each other with no gaps!
challenges.narration: Here comes a straw! Make a smart guess on how many feet long it might be.

challenges.instruction: Time to measure the pencil! Make your best guess for its length, and then tile the feet to find out.
challenges.hint: Look at the other objects we measured to help you make a great guess!
challenges.narration: This pencil is a bit longer! How many feet do you think it will take to measure it?

challenges.instruction: Look at this long toothbrush! Guess how many little feet will fit, then place them all the way across.
challenges.hint: Count slowly as you place each foot down to make sure you get the right number.
challenges.narration: Our last object is a toothbrush. Make your final guess and let us measure!
